description: This file defines the VendorCacheManager class responsible for managing a singleton instance of an Infinispan embedded cache manager, configured via an XML file.

classes.name: VendorCacheManager
classes.description: Manages a singleton instance of an Infinispan cache manager for vendor-related data, with configuration loaded from an XML file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides global access to the singleton instance of VendorCacheManager.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the embedded cache manager instance.
